SF Flow Utility Toolkit

Utilities for Salesforce Flow Builder and related Salesforce automation pages.

A browser extension designed to make working with Salesforce Flows faster, easier, and more consistent through focused admin, builder, and documentation enhancements.

Available on Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge. Free to install.

Featured capabilities

Flow Health Check

Analyse a Flow and identify maintainability, reliability, performance, and portability concerns.

Flow Error Explorer

Translate Salesforce Flow runtime errors into plain English with causes, remediation steps, and AI-ready prompts. Includes a standalone Error Dictionary accessible from Setup at any time.

Import / Export Flows

Export the open Flow as a .flow-meta.xml file, and import a .flow-meta.xml file back into the org as a new version — validated, diffed against what is already there, and inactive by default. No SFDX required.

Scheduled Flow Explorer

View all active Schedule-Triggered Flows across the org and see when each is next scheduled to run, in List View or Calendar View.

Unused Resources Finder

Scan the currently open Flow for variables, formulas, text templates, and other resources that are defined but never used.

Flow List Search

Search and filter the Salesforce Setup Flows list by label, API name, status, and type.

Canvas Search

Search the Flow canvas, connector labels, and toolbox items, then move between results quickly.

API Name Generator

Generate standardised API names for Flow elements and resources using configurable naming patterns and prefixes.

More features

  • Flow Version Manager — bulk-select and delete eligible Flow versions more safely from the versions page.
  • Where Is This Used? — scan flows, quick actions, Lightning pages, LWC components, and buttons and links for references to the current flow. Results can be exported as a CSV.
  • Comparison Exporter — export Flow version comparison results into an Excel workbook using a structured template.
  • Missing Description Flags — highlight elements, resources, and Flow-level items that are missing descriptions.
  • Setup Tabs — add quick-access Setup tabs for key Flow and automation destinations.
  • Flow Trigger Explorer Enhancer — enrich Flow Trigger Explorer rows with inline metadata, context tags, and compact tooltips.
  • Flow Metadata & AI Assistant — work with Flow metadata, copy/download JSON, and generate prompt-ready content for AI-assisted workflows.
  • Autosave — automatically save inactive draft flows in Flow Builder after a configurable period of inactivity.
  • Keyboard Shortcuts — keyboard shortcuts for common Flow Builder actions including Save, Debug, Activate, New Element, and more.
